usedFor: Each new Assinafy workspace gets a matching workspace in Docusign.

bestTemplate.name: “New Workspace Created” in Assinafy, then “Create Workspace” in Docusign
bestTemplate.why: It mirrors each new workspace automatically, whereas “Update Workspace” only handles renames.

watchOut: “New Workspace Created” polls within a set interval, so the mirror lags slightly.
